item.title: Meet the doll collector who helped design the new autistic Barbie
item.description: Noor Pervez, community engagement manager at the Autistic Self Advocacy Network, helped Mattel design a new autistic Barbie.

item.title: How to use AI in work and life
item.description: Whatever you might think of the technology, American workers should prepare themselves for what’s coming next.

item.title: States start imposing expanded SNAP work requirements
item.description: In several states, adults aged 55 to 64 and parents of older teens must prove they’re working, volunteering or doing job training at least 80 hours a month to get food benefits.

item.title: Is Disney too expensive?
item.description: While the parks remain very popular, the costs for families have skyrocketed, pricing out the middle class.

item.title: Washington Post announces major layoffs
item.description: The paper's executive editor says the cuts will include the sports desk, as well as major cuts to the international news team.

item.title: How one startup uses AI
item.description: Focus Fuel is a startup that makes caffeine gummies. Its creators have used artificial intelligence from the very inception of the company.

item.title: Trump's border czar announces 700 immigration officers are leaving Minnesota
item.description: The drawdown comes after the ICE operation there was met with sweeping protests.

item.title: Two high NFL draft picks, two different paths: Maye and Darnold will face off in Super Bowl
item.description: While Drake Maye's success has been immediate, Sam Darnold's has been anything but.

item.title: Does America's new national security strategy actually put 'America First'?
item.description: The Trump Administration has now published its National Security Strategy and its National Defense Strategy. They present an ideological shift in U.S. foreign policy that deprioritizes defending Europe and dilutes focus on China.

item.title: Women's luge athlete from Mass. set to make history at Winter Olympics
item.description: Chevonne Forgan of Chelmsford is competing in her first Olympics, while her sport, women's doubles luge, is also making its Olympics debut.
